name: Create-change loop failed — chain pause marker
description:
ADR-057 §D5 — create-change failure handler (operator surface). Fires when any create-change role terminates with outcome=failed/truncated BEFORE emitting its decide() terminal — model timeout, NATS blip, OOM, panic. Without this rule the failure stalls the chain silently: no downstream rule fires, no operator surface lights up. Stamps a chain.paused.marker triple (subjectless, on the failed loop entity) so operator dashboards + mock-LLM journey assertions can surface the pause.

Pack-local mirror of research/08-loop-failed-pause.json, scoped to create-change roles. The run-phase companion is rule 07 (stamps agent.run.outcome=failed on the run entity); the two fire on the same event with different subjects and do not conflict.

metadata.companion_to: 07-loop-failed-run-outcome.json (run-phase transition). This rule is the operator chain.paused.marker.
metadata.marker_only_note: Marker-only triple (timestamp object). Mirrors research/08 — the marker alone is sufficient for UI / ops-observer queries on chain.paused.*; full classification triples are out of scope for the pack.
